entities.name: GUTI reallocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to allocate a GUTI and optionally provide a new TAI list, new DCN-ID, and in WB-S1 mode with RACS support, either a UE radio capability ID deletion indication or a UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used to identify the UE. The PLMN identity in the GUTI indicates the current registered PLMN.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list provided optionally during GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Dedicated Core Network Identifier provided optionally during GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: UE radio capability identifier provided in WB-S1 mode if UE supports RACS.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Indication for UE radio capability ID deletion provided in WB-S1 mode if UE supports RACS.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state in which the GUTI reallocation procedure can only be initiated by the MME.

entities.name: Ciphered mode
entities.description: Condition where the GUTI reallocation procedure is usually performed.

relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure allocates a GUTI.
GUTI reallocation procedure optionally provides a new TAI list.
GUTI reallocation procedure optionally provides a new DCN-ID.
GUTI reallocation procedure optionally provides a UE radio capability ID in WB-S1 mode with RACS support.
GUTI reallocation procedure optionally provides a UE radio capability ID deletion indication in WB-S1 mode with RACS support.
GUTI reallocation procedure can only be initiated by the MME in EMM-REGISTERED state.
GUTI reallocation procedure is usually performed in ciphered mode.
